newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: ALcatel Singapore gets S$5.9 mln network deal.
newsitem.headline: ALcatel Singapore gets S$5.9 mln network deal.

text.p: 1-Net Singapore Pte Ltd, said on Tuesday it had awarded a Singapore S$5.9 million contract to Alcatel Singapore Pte Ltd to provide network equipment for a nation-wide network project.
1-Net Singapore is a joint venture of Singapore Telecom, Singapore Cable Vision and Singapore Communications Investments, the investment arm of the Telecommunication Authority of Singapore (TAS).
It is involved in the Singapore ONE project launched in June last year to link up homes, businesses and educational institutions throughout the island via high-speed multimedia communications.
The pilot commercial operation of the network to link up homes will start in the middle of this year, a statement said.
